 Judgment
The appellant is the claimant in OP(MV) No.957 of 2017 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Pala.

The said claim petition was filed by the appellant claiming an amount of 3,78,000/-
as compensation for the injuries sustained by her in a motor accident occurred on 01.05.2017.

The tribunal awarded an amount of 89,800/- as compensation under different heads, directing the respondent insurer to deposit the said amount along with interest at the rate of 8% per annum from the date of filing the claim petition, i.e., 04.10.2017, till realization.
Being dissatisfied with the compensation awarded, the appellant has come up in appeal.

2. Today, when the matter came up for consideration, the learned counsel for the appellant as well as the learned Standing Counsel for the respondent insurer submitted that they have filed a joint statement dated 07.08.2024, wherein it is stated that the claim of the appellant has been settled by the respondent insurer, agreeing to deposit a further amount of 1,20,000/- including interest as additional MACA No.3170 of 2019 2024:KER:72033 compensation in the account of the appellant within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment, failing which, the said amount will carry interest at the rate of 8% per annum from the date of default.

3. In the light of the joint statement filed by the parties, the impugned award is modified by directing the respondent insurer to deposit an amount of 1,20,000/- (Rupees One lakh Twenty thousand only) including interest as additional compensation in the account of the appellant within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment, failing which, the said amount will carry interest at the rate of 8% per annum from the date of default.

The claimant shall furnish copies of the PAN Card, AADHAAR Card and bank details before the respondent insurer within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment so as to enable the insurance company to make the deposit as ordered above.
In case of failure to furnish details as above, it shall be open for the insurance company to deposit the said amount before the tribunal.
The appeal is disposed of, in terms of the joint MACA No.3170 of 2019 2024:KER:72033 statement as above.
The joint statement will form part of the judgment.

Sd/-

The OP (MV) No. 957/2017 was filed under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 claiming compensation for the injuries sustained to the appellant in a motor traffic accident, happened on 01-05-2017.
The appellant claims a compensation of  3,78,000/- (three lakhs seventy eight thousand only).

Challenging the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal, the above appeal is preferred.

3. It is agreed that the 3rd respondent Insurance Co shall pay an additional compensation of  1,20,000/-(One lakhs Twenty thousand only), inclusive of all the interests and costs to the appellant, by way of full and final settlement of all the claims of the appellant against the respondents.

4. 5. The above settlement is arrived at without any coercion or undue influence from any corner to either the appellant or to the 3rd respondent.
